label: Baldur's Gate / Generic Fantasy
description: Baldur's Gate: Dark Alliance style classes, Faerûn flavor.
tldr: Baldur's Gate (Dark Alliance-style AD&D) — the classic CRPG feel: 3d6 at the table, ability scores 3–18, class-based hit dice, magic-user spell progression by level, thieves get a % chance table per skill. Combat is Vx-style round-based; spells are the real differentiator — a mage at level 7 is a different animal than at level 3.

links.rules: AD&D rules live in the 5e-compatible 'AD&D SRD' community builds; see the wiki

races.Human: The expansive, ambitious folk of the Sword Coast. Humans define themselves by their deeds, for they have little time to waste.
races.Elf: Graceful and long-lived children of the Seldarine. Elves see centuries drift by and remain beautiful, sharp, and unreachable.
races.Half-Elf: Raised at the meeting of two bloodlines, half-elves carry the grace of elves and the drive of humans — and belong everywhere and nowhere.
races.Dwarf: Stout oath-keepers of the deep holds. A dwarf measures wealth in stone, friendship in trust, and grudges in centuries.
races.Gnome: Bright-eyed tinkers and pranksters with an appetite for the wondrous. Gnomes invent joy as readily as they invent gadgets.
races.Halfling: Small homebodies with huge courage when it counts. Halflings prize comfort, luck, and a well-stocked larder.
races.Half-Orc: Born between fury and mercy. Half-orcs carry their orc strength with a human's conflicted heart.
races.Tiefling: Marked by an otherworldly bloodline, tieflings wear horns and suspicion with a resolve forged by a life of innuendo.

classes.Fighter: The sword-arm of a hundred campaigns. Fighters master weapon and armor until combat becomes second nature.
classes.Ranger: A wanderer at home in the wilds. Rangers track, hunt, and guide the party through a dangerous world.
classes.Paladin: An armored bulwark of sacred oath. Paladins burn bright with conviction and shield the innocent from the dark.
classes.Barbarian: Fury from the frozen north and beyond. A barbarian's rage is a storm that answers every wound with ruin.
classes.Cleric: A living conduit of the gods' will. Clerics mend the broken, smite the wicked, and turn the tide with a prayer.
classes.Druid: A keeper of the Green Man's wild places. Druids speak for beast and tree and shape-shift when words fail.
classes.Monk: A martial artist of the order. Monks perfect the body as a weapon and the mind as a shield.
classes.Rogue: A shadow with deft fingers and a quicker smile. Rogues open locked doors, pockets, and occasionally hearts.
classes.Bard: A minstrel whose music is magic. Bards charm courts, rally armies, and know a song for every occasion.
classes.Sorcerer: Magic from the blood, not the book. Sorcerers bend raw power that was born in them.
classes.Warlock: A pact-seeker bound to an otherworldly patron. Warlocks wield borrowed power — at a price.
classes.Wizard: The scholar of the arcane. Wizards unlock reality through study, ritual, and relentless curiosity.
